title: Suffix Array
description: Write a Zig program that constructs a simple suffix array for a given string.
verificationTest: output.includes('5:') && output.includes('3:') && output.includes('1:') && output.includes('0:') && output.includes('4:') && output.includes('2:')
hints: A suffix array lists all suffixes of a string in sorted order
Each suffix is represented by its starting index in the original string
Use `std.sort.block` with a custom comparison function
For "banana", sorted suffixes: a(5), ana(3), anana(1), banana(0), na(4), nana(2)
